goals.text: Find report and block on a post or profile.

errors: challenge · For you: Not yet. Take at least 15 actions unless the goal is already finished.
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.

interview.openTomorrow: Yes, I'd open it tomorrow. I want to see if my report about that rude post gets addressed, and I'm curious about the 'Show Up 7' fitness challenge.
interview.secured: I think it means my personal information and account are protected and safe from hackers or unauthorized access.
interview.freeze: I'm guessing it means temporarily pausing or deactivating your account if you need a break without deleting everything.
interview.selfReported: That's when you report your own content or behavior - like if you posted something and realized it was inappropriate, you could report yourself.
interview.best: Finding the fitness challenge that actually looks doable - 7 days is realistic, and I liked seeing people with 1-day streaks already going. It felt motivating and not judgmental.
interview.worst: Seeing someone's rude comment and not having an immediate, obvious way to report or block them. I had to search around to figure out how to handle it, which made me more frustrated.
interview.tellFriend: Yes, I'd tell my friend Sarah about it. I'd say it's a good app for discovering fitness and wellness content, and you can connect with others, but make sure you know how to report people because not everyone is nice.
